purpose: Prevent rejected ideas from being silently reintroduced and force new development to target an unresolved algorithm layer.

components.evidence: Campanula cached candidate pools could reach only 13/19 field clusters at 1 km; full-island search removed this upstream ceiling.

components.rule: use spatial thinning to reduce duplicate-record dominance; do not interpret the thinning distance as a biological universal constant
components.evidence: Campanula 500 m thinning stabilized prototype representation; naive use of dense nearby records distorted scaling and support density.
Local environmental evidence repeatedly survived simplification in the Practical Core and NDVI-state support retained a low-budget within-island signal after strong coverage controls.
The frozen Campanula hybrid and NDVI-only rankings both lost to same-allocation random on the 16-taxon unseen transfer; budget sweeps showed no stable low-budget ranking lift.
Strong maximum-covered-land selection dominated simple farthest-first and exposed when environmental support added value beyond geometry.

At q=0.10, K=5, r=1 km, support-constrained max coverage beat both global max coverage and a same-island-allocation environment-free control by +0.030 with positive bootstrap lower bounds and sign-flip p<0.05. No broad fixed-q claim is allowed.
q=0.10 is a development reference only; the same five-island frame is exhausted for a large untouched confirmation and fixed parameters are not assumed transferable.

The training-only LOO environmental-reconstruction selector chose q=1 in 60/80 folds; at K=5 it tied global coverage and was 0.030 below fixed q10. Internal environmental reconstruction was misaligned with downstream survey recovery.

components.rule: choose support breadth only from inner spatial held-out survey-set recovery within each outer training fold; outer held-out coordinates remain invisible

components.evidence: The 0.90 NDVI + 0.10 joint microclimate Campanula rule failed the predeclared 16-taxon transfer and underperformed NDVI-only with CI entirely below zero.
Static categorical land-cover composition did not improve the Campanula terrain/NDVI frontier.

Transition, gradient, and heterogeneity variants did not beat simpler NDVI state in Campanula development. The conceptual transition idea is not promoted without a new representation and new evidence.
Requiring connected persistent support eliminated genuine Campanula detections or required excessive expansion. Patch structure may remain an operational output, not a required truth criterion.
Canonical Campanula patch sets could be sharp, but outer prototype deletion showed strong sensitivity; the robust support envelope was more defensible than a fixed finite patch set.
NDVI support area did not beat global max coverage and did not beat simpler allocation controls.
Smoothed occurrence-count allocation did not pass the predeclared bootstrap gate at K=20 and was clearly worse than global coverage in the q10/K5 decomposition.

Earlier plant/animal and v2.1 development repeatedly collapsed toward local-only under stronger nested validation; geometry remains useful as a set objective rather than a universal additive score weight.

components.rule: infer from training data whether the terrestrial support/coverage policy is applicable; do not silently apply a land-grid policy to marine or aquatic taxa
components.evidence: Historical mixed-taxon failures and the predeclared outside-Izu cohort audit both expose domain mismatch as a separate problem.

components.rule: K, time, distance, or surveyed area are operational budgets, not biological parameters tuned on held-out outcomes
components.evidence: The 793-point/1-km design produced random saturation (~0.86 recall), demonstrating that point count without footprint accounting is not a meaningful field budget.

components.rule: environmental value must beat controls matched on candidate universe/budget and, where relevant, island allocation; random alone is insufficient when a strong geometry-only selector exists.
development choices use inner or development data only; new taxa/regions remain untouched until the full procedure is frozen; inspected cohorts are never recycled as confirmation.

anti_churn_rule: A new experiment must name one unresolved layer, preserve retained components unless directly testing them, and compare against the strongest surviving control.
